resources.string: Search the installed data selected when you open this screen. Preparation is local and does not download cards.
Example: mv<=3 type:creature. Combine filters with AND, OR, NOT and parentheses; quote names containing spaces.
Printing filters find a printing that matches all conditions together. A negated printing filter tests that printing; it does not exclude every printing of the card.
Different face filters may match different faces. Missing values stay unknown, including under NOT.
The full expression must match one face. The complete card name can also match; card-wide fields keep their meaning.
Use original card-level fields, without selecting a front face. Missing card fields stay unknown.
Prepare this installed data before using advanced filters.
Preparation is incomplete. Continue to finish the remaining local work.
Preparation failed. Review the error before retrying.
Collection, selected-deck and price filters are not available in this search yet. Other unsupported source or language combinations are also rejected.
Check the query near characters %1$d–%2$d. Verify operators, parentheses and quoted text.
No matching cards in this data.
